notes.title: Update-20190529
notes.content: Dear Community! In the last week I had implemented the language selection option in the game. Although the translation was made by a professional translation office, there may be errors in it, so if you find an error in the localization, please drop me a mail and I will fix it. The following languages are supported now (in alphabetical order): Chinese, English, French, German, Hungarian, Russian and Spanish. I hope, many of yours will find the game more user friendly in your native language! Adding other languages is not too hard from now, but I will have to concentrate on the graphics and new levels in the next few weeks!

notes.title: Update-20190522
notes.content:
Dear Community! First of all, thank you for your feedbacks! A few issues arose since the release, i'll resolve them as soon as possible. To ease the debugging, you can turn on logging in the Delivered.cfg file, setting the <debug log="0" /> parameter to "1". A "Delivered.log" file will be placed on the Windows desktop, this is what I need if the game crashes on your machine.
In the meantime i switched from Visual Studio 2017 to VS2019 which may requires you to update the Windows redistributables vc_redist.x86.exe and/or vc_redist.x64.exe, here: [url=https://support.microsoft.com/ms-my/help/2977003/the-latest-supported-visual-c-downloads] [/url].
